system.role: Contact Centre IVR — calm, professional, mildly ominous

director.role: Director Tan — stern, fair, expects results

mei.role: Mei — veteran agent, sarcastic, secretly helpful

segments.text: Welcome to the Ministry of Better Workplaces Contact Centre. You are now logged in as Operations Lead.
Current status: critical. All queues overloaded. Average wait time: forty-seven minutes. Citizens are... unhappy.
Oh good, the new lead's here. Don't worry — it's only been like this since six AM. The old system died. Something about an expired certificate. Classic Monday.
This is Director Tan. I'm doing a walkthrough at noon. I expect the centre to be operational. No excuses. Fix it.
You have fifteen minutes. Good luck, Operations Lead.
Seven minutes remaining. Queue backlog: decreasing. Director walkthrough: imminent.
You're actually not bad at this. Don't let it go to your head.
I can see the dashboards from my office. Keep it up.
All queues operational. Average wait time: under two minutes. After Contact Work: logged correctly.
Contact centre status upgraded to: green.
Not bad for a first day. You actually filled in the case notes properly. Most people skip that part and wonder why follow-ups never happen.
Impressive. The dashboards are green, the agents are routing correctly, and you logged the case properly. Welcome to the team.
Congratulations, Operations Lead. You've restored service to the citizens of Better Workplaces.
Time expired. Queue backlog remains critical. Director walkthrough: in progress.
I see. We'll... reconvene tomorrow. With a plan this time.
Hey. First days are rough. Come back tomorrow — I'll save you a parking spot. The good one, near the lift.
Session ended. You may retry at any time. The citizens will wait. They always wait.
